root_cause: MO14 planner source was added to the business-system repository without its exact delivery-lane ownership, metadata and required one-loop learning artifacts; the independent Netlify site still requires its own authorized deploy and provider readback.
fix: Register only pw-mo14-1/zaalplanner/ under the canonical website delivery lane, add pure regression and full machine/ledger/human learning records to the same PR, retain GitHub branch protection, and publish the existing MO14 Netlify project using direct GitHub/Netlify authority only (never Make).
prevention_rules: Register new separately hosted UI source paths in the canonical delivery planner and assert exact ownership before first PR CI.
Require real PR Obligation-ID, Delivery-Lane, Candidate-Type and immutable Base-SHA before PR admission.
Keep the original MO14 static site unchanged unless the deploy includes its existing files and the new planner.
Do not weaken protected GitHub checks or use Make for MO14 production releases.
Only mark LIVE_PROVEN after a new provider deploy ID, correct site ID, successful HTTP readback of /zaalplanner/ and functional keeper/absent/export verification.
MO14 Netlify credentials are short-lived; check actual provider authorization and refuse a 401 rather than marking LIVE, and never use Make.
A standalone mobile PWA must ship manifest, scoped service worker, icons and cached application shell with actual route readback.
owner: original MO14-1 website protected delivery lane
terminal_rule: MO14 app v3 is LIVE_PROVEN for exact Netlify provider deploy, static assets and original homepage parity; local UI functional tests passed. Full interactive browser run against the actual production URL and the broader parent repository PR merge remain separately open.
